name: feed_view_options
description: Show/hide feed thumbnail footer fields (creator, status, tags, comments, name) — same as topbar View options. Use when the user asks to enable/disable any of them or all. Pass "all" to flip every field.

disable.description: Fields to hide. "all" = hide footer (master off).

enable.description: Fields to show. "all" = every field + footer on.
